title: Plenums.
officialText:
Where the space above a suspended ceiling is continuous and part of the supply or return air plenum
system, this space shall be included in calculating the volume of the enclosed space.
SECTION MC 1105
MACHINERY ROOM, GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
